The '''Theed Royal Palace''' of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was a magnificent edifice located on the edge of a cliff in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Serving as the residence of the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|planetary monarch]] and the nerve center of the government, the ancient palace stood through the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] collapse and the birth of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] several decades later.

==Description==
[[File:Theedroyalpalace.png|thumb|right|250px|Theed Palace during the Invasion of Naboo.]]

===Exterior===
The Royal Palace of Theed was a massive complex of sandstone-like blocks formed into [[Classical Naboo style/Legends|towers and rotundas]] with cupolas covered in green tile. The largest structure in the city, it was the home of the planetary government and the destination of foreign diplomats and ambassadors. A central drum-shaped structure took up the majority of the complex, with a taller, narrower tower being the tallest point. Erected on a cliff face, the palace had several watch towers on the rocky face, placed to detect a rear attack from the valley below. Additions to the palace during each new administration was traditional and a way for the new monarch to curry favor with their constituents.<ref name="SWCL" />

The palace was surrounded by a vast garden complex. A pool in the garden was capable of being drained; it had a control for a nearby bridge. A security gate required a passcode for entrance and exit into the garden. A secret passage led through the garden to the Theed Hangar.<ref name="E1 game">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>

===Interior===
[[File:Naboo_Throne_Room.png|thumb|left|250px|The palace throne room.]]
Filled with vast, cavernous corridors crafted by Naboo's own artisans, the Royal Palace was a showcase of the great sculptors and craftsmen of the planet.<ref name="SWCL" /> The main entrance to the complex was located at the terminus of [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]], a broad promenade which was crowned at the opposite end by the [[Palace Courtyard/Legends|Palace Courtyard]],<ref name="ROTS" /> erected in the aftermath of the Trade Federation invasion in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Triumphal Arch/Legends|Triumphal Arch]] stood halfway between the fountain-filled courtyard and the steps of the palace, which were lined with towering statues of famed philosophers who helped shape the constitution of Naboo's government.<ref name="SWCL" />

Within one of the lower rotundas near to the entrance was the nerve center of politics on Naboo; the throne room of the planet's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]], a vaulted chamber with tall windows. The throne rested behind the desk of office with several chairs around which to accommodate members of the court. The throne was made not only for comfort, to reflect the calm serenity maintained on the planet, but also for function. Control panels on the armrests monitored incoming transmissions and several holdout pistols were kept securely in reach. Further back within the palace was the audience chamber of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]], a body of noblemen and women from the city who advised the monarch on social issues as well as more mundane aspects of politics.<ref name="SWCL" />

During the palace's early years, King [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] began the tradition of expanding the original structure. Establishing a square turret on the rear of the palace, he included a temple to past rulers and a lavish residence hall to house dignitaries from off-world. Following the tradition, King [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] constructed a massive library during his reign over the planet.<ref name="SWCL" />

==History==
===Construction and corruption===
[[File:TheedPalace_night.png|thumb|left|250px|The Royal Palace at night.]]
Following the unification of Naboo circa [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]], the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was established by settlers fleeing a revolution on their own planet. Led by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]], the people erected a palace on the cliff side to serve as the seat of their new planet-wide government. During King Jafan's reign, the monarch began a tradition that each consecutive ruler would follow, adding a new building to the massive structure. Jafan's addition a massive tower containing the Turret Room and a small temple would be a place for future monarchs to pay homage to the past leaders of Naboo.<ref name="SWCL" />

In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], King [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]] occupied the palace and was known for throwing raucous parties and indulging in nefarious business deals within the palace walls; he erected a tower alongside the palace in accordance with Jafan's tradition. One such meeting occurred deep within the central building, in a banquet hall set to receive the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]]. The Muuns pitched a scheme to exploit the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] rich planet and export the refined substance out of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in exchange for funding Tapalo's reelection campaign. Ultimately the deal was struck and Naboo ascended to the greater galactic plasma industry.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

In a similar fashion, King [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] continued to welcome corrupt guests into the palace, such as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Underlord]] [[Alexi Garyn]] and [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and her [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] guards. When the Naboo became disenchanted with Veruna's handling of the worsening relationship with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the king was forced to abdicate and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was elected as his successor. <ref name="DP" />

===Invasion of Naboo===
[[File:Theed_Plaza.png|thumb|right|250px|The Trade Federation droid army secures the Palace Plaza and surrounding buildings.]]
Bringing in reform, Queen Amidala scarcely ruled before the Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the planet<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] directed the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] during the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|Capture of Theed]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Their strategy involved working towards the palace while spreading their forces throughout the city.<ref name="Fact File 29">{{FactFile|29|NAB 11-16|The Capture of Theed}}</ref> After OOM-9's droids destroyed a [[Theed signal jammer|signal jammer]] in Theed&mdash;allowing the Trade Federation to land their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] within the city&mdash;Gunray instructed him to send at least five droids into the palace grounds to claim them. After that, Gunray ordered OOM-9 to have [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] construct a [[Neimoidian Throne]] next to the palace,<ref name="GB" /> hoping to prove the Trade Federation's superiority and demoralize the Naboo.<ref name="GB Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The labor droids completed the monument in Palace Plaza while being defended by OOM-9's army.<ref name="GB" />

Gunray took up residence in the palace in as the Trade Federation occupied the planet. Eventually, Queen Amidala returned to Naboo with two members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to put an [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|end to the occupation]]. Escorted by members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Amidala forced her way into the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|main hangar]] alongside the [[Plasma Refinery Complex]]. From the hangar, Amidala and her soldiers were able to reach the base of the palace, using a little-known route to gain access to the spacious, ceremonial halls. Reaching the central tower, the queen and her escort use their [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension guns]] to scale the palace walls, avoiding the bulk of the Federation army patrolling the halls. As the group descended to the [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)/Legends|throne room]] level, the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the Trade Federation outnumbered them, and the Naboo were disarmed and escorted inside. Defenseless and seemingly at the mercy of Viceroy Gunray the arrival of Amidala's decoy, [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], turned the tide of the palace battle. Amidala was able to arm herself with pistol's concealed in the throne and her men made short work of the battle droids that remained in the room. With the Viceroy detained and after the destruction of the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Federation's Droid Control Ship]] and their army of droids, the battle to retake the planet was over.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Theed.png|thumb|left|250px|The liberation of Theed and the Royal Palace.]]
In the days following the end of the occupation, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Perpetuus/Legends|''Perpetuus'']] arrived in [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] carrying several members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and recently elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The Neimoidian of the Trade Federation were escorted out of the Palace and placed under Republic authority and transported off-world. The members of the High Council were quartered in the Turret Room during the week surrounding the [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]] for Master Jinn, who had been slain during the fighting. A parade celebrating the unity between the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] societies was held in Palace Plaza at this time, at which time the Queen gave the Gungan leader, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], the [[Globe of Peace/Legends|Globe of Peace]].<ref name="TPM" />

===Post-invasion===
In the wake of destruction that had plagued Naboo, Amidala finished out her reign as Queen and was replaced by [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> Taking up residence in the palace, the complex remained in use through the reigns of Queens [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]]<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Valley">''[[The Clone Wars: The Valley]]''</ref> and [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]]; both of whom ruled during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the war ended abruptly and the Republic was replaced with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] arrived at the palace with the body of Naboo's former queen and senator, Padmé Amidala. Amidala's body was carried out of the palace during a grand [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral procession]] attended by all of Theed and countless of the politician's friends and colleagues from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>

As the Empire tightened its grip on Naboo, Queen Apailana was discovered to be sheltering fugitives of the Empire, namely members of the now-outlawed Jedi Order. Sending down [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to enforce martial law on the city, the Empire seized the palace and killed the queen.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> Installing the loyal Queen [[Kylantha]] in the palace, Naboo remained within the Empire for the duration of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] reign. When word of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death reached the palace in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], throngs of Naboo and Gungans [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|swarmed]] Palace Plaza and the Palace in rebellion against the local Imperial garrison. Taking the palace and routing the Imperials, the Naboo went on to gain independence from the Empire shortly thereafter.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NabooRoyalPalace-TPMP.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Theed Royal Palace concept art by [[Doug Chiang]]]]
The interior scenes in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] were shot in the [[Caserta Palace]] near [[Wikipedia:Naples|Naples]].

The exterior design was directly inspired by the [[Wikipedia:Marin County Civic Center|Marin County Civic Center]] in San Rafael, California which was designed by [[Wikipedia:Frank Lloyd Wright|Frank Lloyd Wright]]. The building features round designs set into the hillside with characteristic blue domed roofs. Scenes from [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX-1138'']] and [[Wikipedia:Gattaca|''Gattaca'']] were also filmed there.

In the video game ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles]]'', Theed Palace and the Theed Palace hangar are directly connected by a spiral stairwell that leads off the Throne Room, contradicting several other sources.
